meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每次回答前会先查看之前存下的记忆,回答完也会把本轮新信息存进去。记忆保存在指定文件夹,重启容器不丢失。
howto.when: 每次对话轮次都会自动触发,但仅在使用默认 Claude provider(如 claude-code)时生效。回答前检索相关记忆,回答后存入新见解。

say.text: 记得我们上次聊过的项目背景吗?
say.note: Claude 会从记忆里找出相关部分回答。

say.text: 请记住:我每周三开例会。
say.note: 本轮结束后该信息会被存入长期记忆。

say.text: 根据之前定的方案,给我推荐一个。
say.note: Claude 会结合旧记忆给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recalls relevant stored memories before each response and saves new insights after each turn. Memory lives in a designated folder and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on every conversation turn, but only for default Claude provider groups (claude-code target). Claude recalls past context before answering and stores new insights after each turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project background we discussed last time?
Please remember: I have a weekly meeting every Wednesday.
say_en.note: This info is saved to long-term memory after this turn.

say_en.text: Based on our earlier decision, recommend an option.
say_en.note: Claude uses prior memory to suggest.
